name: What should I prepare before a virtual tour photoshoot?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before a virtual tour photoshoot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before a luxury real estate virtual tour photoshoot, proper preparation is crucial to ensure the best presentation of the property. This involves decluttering all spaces, depersonalizing rooms, and ensuring the property is immaculately clean and staged, just as you would for an in-person showing. Exterior areas, including landscaping, pools, and outdoor living spaces, should also be pristine. Any minor repairs or touch-ups should be completed beforehand. Your agent can provide a detailed checklist to help ensure every detail, from lighting to furniture arrangement, is optimized for the camera.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by decluttering, depersonalizing, cleaning, staging, and ensuring the exterior is pristine. Your agent can provide a checklist.
